_readme: Every USSD screen Noor sees. The Lambda reads this file; edit wording here, not in code.
Fill in every 'rw'. Keep the {placeholders} exactly as written; you can move them around.
\n is a new line. Keep options in the same order: the code maps option numbers to the 'options' keys.
'CON' or 'END' is added by the code: CON waits for a reply, END closes the session.
Check with: python3 backend/check_ussd.py   (aim for 160 characters or fewer per screen)

pending.en: Your coop officer is reviewing your input credit. We will SMS you when it is ready.

no_history.en: Input credit needs 2 seasons of cherry deliveries to the coop. Please talk to your coop officer.

problem.en:
What is the problem?
1. Spots on leaves
2. Insects or damaged berries
3. Pale yellow leaves
4. Dry, wilting trees
5. Old trees, low harvest
6. Not sure

needs_photo.en: Please bring 5 affected leaves or berries to {centre} so we can check them before you buy treatment.

order_done.en: Order sent. Collect at {centre}. RWF {total} will come off your next cherry payments.

refer.en: We are not sure what this is. Your extension officer will contact you.

cancelled.en: No order placed. Dial again anytime.

too_low.en: Your credit (RWF {limit}) is below the cheapest treatment (RWF {cheapest}). Talk to your coop officer.

not_registered.en: This number is not registered with FarmFlow. Please visit your washing station.
